profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA, with ticker symbol ADBE. Its most recent annual filing, a 10-K covering the period ending November 28, 2025, reported revenue of $23,769,000,000. The company's website for Adobe Express describes it as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool aimed at making content creation easy, with stated uses including social content, videos, and logos.

Adobe offers several AI-oriented products across design, video, and audio categories. Adobe Express incorporates an AI Assistant that the site describes as allowing users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements, and it integrates with Adobe Firefly, the company's image generation model, which Adobe describes as trained in a way that is safe for commercial use. Premiere Pro AI adds generative video capabilities including generative extend and color match, also under the same commercial-safe training claim, and Adobe Podcast AI provides audio and speech enhancement tools with a similar claim about its training data.

The held facts record no litigation and no MCP server presence for Adobe. The company does hold a CIK of 0000796343 with the SEC, consistent with its status as a publicly traded corporation.
